en.name: URL Parameters

en.title: URL parser: decode query string parameters online
en.description: Break any URL into a decoded key/value table with search: repeated keys, # fragment parameters, nested redirect_uri URLs and JSON, Base64 or JWT values detected. Edit values and rebuild the URL. 100% in your browser.
